verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Your love is the rock that I cling to
Your name is the tower that I run into
Your strength is what lifts my head
when it’s bowed low
Your song is the light that shines through my window

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
And like the sun after all of the rain’s gone
The morning without any cloud comes
With a picture of Your love
And when I think of the stars so high over me
The moon in the darkness lets everyone see
A picture of Your love

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
And after the rain has fallen
And after the clouds all roll away
The sweetest name remains on my soul

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
You’re faithful (You’re always the same)
You’re faithful (God, You never change)
You’re faithful
You’re always good, You’re always good

verse.name: b3a
verse.lines:
Though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death
I have no doubt, You’ve already gone ahead
My fire by night, my cloud by day

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
Faithful, You're always faithful
True, You're always true
You'll never leave me
You're always with me
You're good, You're good

verse.name: b3b
verse.lines:
Though ten thousand may fall to my right and my left
Under the shadow of the Most High I find rest
My fire by night, my cloud by day

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Though weeping may last for a night
Your joy comes in the morning
Though sorrow may last for a time
Your joy comes in the morning

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
I sought the Lord and He heard me
I sought the Lord and He heard my cry
